## About
Minis are in Graham Reid's blood. He dragged his first one home from a Scottish scrap yard while working as an apprentice mechanic, and he has truly lost count of the number that have passed through his hands.
After years at a Jaguar shop in California and some vintage racing at Willow Springs, Graham started doing Mini repairs on the side for other racers. The Mini work kept growing until he sold off the Jaguar and Range Rover business and Heritage Garage was born.
Today the shop on Pomona Avenue handles everything from a routine service to bumper to bumper restorations, with paint and body done in house. Customers rate us 4.8 from 33 Google reviews.

## Services
- Classic Mini maintenance: Oil changes, brake inspections and performance upgrades to keep your classic Mini ready for the road.
- New MINI service: The same quality service and attention to detail, for New MINI owners.
- Full restorations: From small repairs to full bumper to bumper Concours restorations.
- Bodywork and paint: Bodywork and paint done in house.
- Engine and transmission rebuilds
- Component rebuilds: Fast turnaround on brake calipers, carburetors and rear swing arms.
- Swing arm refurbishing: Swing arm assemblies refurbished to as new condition with new bushings and bearings.
- Drum to disc brake conversion
- Right hand drive to left hand drive conversions: Right hand drive to left hand drive, and the other way around.
- Accident repair
- Classic Mini parts: Classic Mini parts, shipped worldwide.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on the new MINI too?
A: Yes. We have expanded our workshop to handle all the service needs of the new generation MINI.

Q: Can you ship parts to me?
A: Yes. We ship Classic Mini parts worldwide.

Q: Can someone help me find the right part?
A: Yes. Everyone at Heritage is an experienced Mini owner and can help you find the right part for your car.

Q: When are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.
